scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Hello, what business are you here for?
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
你好，请问你来这里有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
If you wish to join the Illusion Investigation Corps, you're lacking in skills yet.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
想加入幻觉调查队的话，你目前的实力还不够。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Please visit again when you have reached a certain level.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
等你达到一定等级后，再来找我吧。

scripts.text: ^4d4dff== You must be level 100 or higher to join. ==^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff== 角色等级须达到100级或以上才能加入。 ==^000000

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Hello, I'm Joel, the Commander of the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
你好，我是乔尔，幻觉调查队的指挥官。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Have you ever heard of or experienced illusions?
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
你听说过幻觉，或亲身经历过吗？

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Until now, illusions have been discovered all over the world and are somewhat known to the public.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
如今，世界各地都发现了幻觉现象，公众也已经对此有所了解。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
It is also used as a hunting ground for many adventurers because it is easy to obtain rare materials.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
幻觉区域很容易找到稀有材料，因此成了许多冒险者的狩猎场。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Also, the monsters in Illusion are new monsters that have never been discovered before, and the monsters in Illusion are multiplying abnormally.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
幻觉中的魔物都是此前从未发现过的新种，而且数量正在异常繁殖。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Despite many adventurers hunting the monsters that exist in Illusion to obtain materials, the reason for the very rapid recovery of the population has not been identified.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
许多冒险者为了收集材料而猎杀幻觉中的魔物，但它们的数量为何能如此迅速地恢复，至今仍未查明。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Our Illusion Investigation Team was organized to uncover the mystery of the Illusion, and first we decided to figure out the ecology of the monsters inside the Illusion.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
我们成立幻觉调查队，就是为了揭开幻觉的谜团。首先要弄清幻觉中魔物的生态。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
What we found was that all illusions are affected by dimensional rifts.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
调查发现，所有幻觉现象都受到次元裂缝的影响。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
I've been speculating that it might be related to the dimensional rift for a long time, but with the results of this investigation, it's clear.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
我一直猜测这可能与次元裂缝有关，而这次调查结果证实了这一点。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
There are still many adventurers visiting Illusion with a purpose, so the monster population is fortunately maintained.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
幸好仍有许多冒险者为了各自的目的前往幻觉区域，魔物数量才得以维持。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
If no one sets foot there, it's very dangerous because the monsters can go beyond saturation and invade other areas.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
如果没有人前往，魔物数量就可能过度增长，甚至侵入其他区域，那会非常危险。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
For that reason, the number of individuals is still being investigated, and one investigator is currently assigned to each illusion.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
因此，我们仍在调查魔物的数量，并为每处幻觉区域派驻了一名调查员。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
And we're recruiting members with the ability to control the number of monsters inside Illusion.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
我们正在招募能够控制幻觉区域内魔物数量的成员。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
And if you're an adventurer, you seem to be strong enough for that role...
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
而你身为冒险者，似乎有足够的实力胜任这项工作...

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Would you like to join the Illusion Investigation Team and join us in investigating illusions?
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
你愿意加入幻觉调查队，和我们一起调查幻觉吗？

scripts.text: I'm joining
scripts.translation: 我加入

scripts.text: I'll think about it
scripts.translation: 我再考虑一下

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
It's very meaningful.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
这项工作很有意义。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Please think about it before you tell me.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
请考虑清楚后再答复我。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Okay, you're welcome!!
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
好，欢迎加入！！

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
The procedure is simple, please fill out the pledge here...
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
手续很简单，请在这里填写誓约书...

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Here... please sign this.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
来，在这里签个名。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
...

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
..
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
...

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
...
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
...

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Yes, with this you have become a member of the Illusionary Survey Corps, welcome again!
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
很好，这样你就正式成为幻觉调查队的一员了。再次欢迎你！

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
If you have time during your adventure, I would like you to stop by the Illusions located in various places and help me with the investigation.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
冒险途中有空的话，希望你能顺路前往各地的幻觉区域，协助我们调查。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
A dispatched investigator will guide you.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
我们派驻的调查员会为你带路。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Then I hope you have a nice day
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
那么，祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
I think the investigation will be much easier thanks to you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
多亏有你帮忙，调查工作应该会顺利许多，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
New illusions will appear again.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
还会有新的幻觉出现。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Every new discovery takes a lot of time for us to adapt to it
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
每次发现新的幻觉现象，我们都需要花很多时间适应。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
This investigation will at least help reduce that time.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
至少，这次调查能帮我们缩短适应所需的时间。

scripts.text:
[Commander Joel]
Thank you and look forward to many more activities in the future.
scripts.translation:
[指挥官乔尔]
谢谢你，也期待今后能与你一起开展更多工作。

scripts.text:
[Member Zenhi]
Hello~~!!
scripts.translation:
[成员泽恩希]
你好~~！！

scripts.text:
[Member Zenhi]
The Illusion Investigation Corps is getting bigger little by little.
scripts.translation:
[成员泽恩希]
幻觉调查队正在逐渐壮大。

scripts.text:
[Member Zenhi]
The more members, the more things we can do, right?
scripts.translation:
[成员泽恩希]
成员越多，我们能做的事情也越多，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Member Zenian]
Hello, I'm Zenian, a new member of the team.
scripts.translation:
[成员泽尼安]
你好，我是泽尼安，刚加入调查队。

scripts.text:
[Member Zenian]
I've been paying attention to the phenomenon of dimensional rifts for a long time. Clearly, despite many subjugations, monsters are constantly appearing.
scripts.translation:
[成员泽尼安]
我关注次元裂缝现象已经很久了。明明已经进行过多次讨伐，魔物却还是不断出现。

scripts.text:
[Member Zenian]
It has been proven that this phenomenon also occurs in illusions, so I decided to join the Illusion Investigation Team.
scripts.translation:
[成员泽尼安]
如今已证实幻觉中也有同样的现象，所以我决定加入幻觉调查队。

scripts.text:
[Member Zenian]
Good luck in the future!!
scripts.translation:
[成员泽尼安]
祝大家今后一切顺利！！

scripts.text:
[Member link]
Nice to meet you, this is the Welcome Survey Team.
scripts.translation:
[成员林克]
你好，很高兴认识你。我是欢迎调查组的成员。

scripts.text:
[Member link]
Investigate the ecosystem of monsters in Illusion...
scripts.translation:
[成员林克]
调查幻觉中魔物的生态...

scripts.text:
[Member link]
Also... I thought it might have something to do with the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[成员林克]
还有...我觉得这可能和次元裂缝有关。

scripts.text:
[Member link]
I hope that everyone who is working hard at this time will return safely without any incident.
scripts.translation:
[成员林克]
希望此刻正在努力调查的大家都能平安归来，不要出任何意外。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Hello!!
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
你好！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
I am J-Girocker from the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
我是幻觉调查队的J-吉罗克。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Ugh... to really come to a place like this... I wish adventurers would help me too...
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
唉...居然真的要来这种地方...真希望冒险者也能来帮帮我...

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
You haven't joined the investigation team yet.
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
你还没有加入调查队。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Would you like to investigate the monsters here with me? It will definitely be meaningful!!
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
愿意和我一起调查这里的魔物吗？这项工作很有意义！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Please apply for membership to <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the investigator in Prontera, and come!!
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
请先向普隆德拉的调查员<NAVI>[乔尔]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>申请加入，然后再过来！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Hello!!
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
你好！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
I am J-Girocker from the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
我是幻觉调查队的J-吉罗克。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Ugh... To come to a place like this...
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
唉...居然跑到这种地方来了...

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
I usually pretended to be brave, but I think I was conscious of Elysia, the member I have a crush on.
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
我平时总是假装勇敢...其实是因为我一直在意暗恋的队员伊莉西亚。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Actually, I'm the one who's more timid than anyone else... heck
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
说真的，我才是最胆小的那个...唉。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Anyway... I'm in charge of investigating this place.
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
总之，这里的调查由我负责。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Have you heard about the investigation from Captain Joel? Adventurer, you have to completely hunt 100 monsters by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
你听指挥官乔尔说过调查的事了吗？冒险者，你得独自击杀100只魔物。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Would you like to participate in the investigation of this place?
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
你愿意参与这里的调查吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参加

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Then should I ask another adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
那我只好去问问其他冒险者了...

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
I like it!!
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
太好了！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Just kill 100 monsters of any type here.
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
在这里随便击杀100只魔物就行。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
那就小心行动！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Ah, that's enough for today's investigation.
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
啊，今天的调查就到这里吧。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
It will be restored tomorrow, so if you can afford it, I would appreciate it if you could come and help me with the investigation!!
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
明天就会重置。如果你有空，还请再来帮我调查！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Hello, are you here today to help with the investigation?
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
你好，今天是来帮忙调查的吗？

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
The content is the same as last time.
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
调查内容和上次一样。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate?
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
只要击杀100只任意种类的魔物。你愿意参加吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参加

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
It would be nice if you could help me today...
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
你今天要是能帮帮我就好了...

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
I like it!!
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
太好了！！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Just kill 100 monsters of any type here.
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
在这里击杀100只任意种类的魔物就行。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
那就小心行动！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
You're back safely!
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
你平安回来了！

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Okay... Then hmm... I'll have to wait and see how much monsters spawn for a while.
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
好...嗯...接下来我得观察一阵子，看看魔物的刷新情况。

scripts.text:
[Girocker]
Leave the rest to me!! Thanks!!
scripts.translation:
[吉罗克]
剩下的交给我吧！！谢谢！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Oh, must you have a hard time enduring the cold here?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
这里这么冷，你一定很难熬吧？

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Come back when you're a little hotter.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
等你暖和些再回来吧。

scripts.text: ^4d4dff== This is a level 120 or higher quest. ==^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff== 这是等级达到120级或以上才能接取的任务。 ==^000000

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Hello~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
你好~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
I'm Elysia from the Illusion Investigation Team~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
我是幻觉调查队的伊莉西亚~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
It's really cold here...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
这里真的好冷啊...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
I'd like to ask the adventurer for help...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
冒险者，能不能请你帮个忙...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
You haven't joined the investigation team yet.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
你还没有加入调查队。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
If you don't mind, why don't you join the Illusionary Survey Corps? Then you can help me!!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
如果你不介意，要不要加入幻觉调查队？这样就能帮帮我了！！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Please apply for membership to <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera, and come!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
请先向普隆德拉的指挥官<NAVI>[乔尔]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>申请加入，然后过来找我！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Hello~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
你好~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
I'm Elysia from the Illusion Investigation Team~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
我是幻觉调查队的伊莉西亚~

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
It's really cold here...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
这里真的好冷啊...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
I never thought I would be sent to such a dangerous place alone... I wanted to come with Jirocker...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
没想到我会被单独派到这么危险的地方...真希望能和吉罗克一起来。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Well, even if there was a Jirocker, he's a coward, so I'd be in a position to protect him...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
不过就算吉罗克来了，他也很胆小，到时候恐怕还得由我来保护他...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
You pretended to be brave... but I already noticed
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
你一直在装勇敢...其实我早就看出来了。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Is Jirocker doing his investigation safely in the abandoned village? I'm worried.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
吉罗克在废弃村庄里调查还安全吗？我有点担心。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Hmm... Actually, now is not the time to worry about Jirocker, Adventurer. Can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
嗯...冒险者，现在还不是担心吉罗克的时候。你能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Did you hear that this is an investigation into how the monster population is maintained? Many adventurers come here to hunt, but it's a bit lacking.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
听说过这次调查是为了查明魔物数量为何能维持不变吗？很多冒险者都来这里狩猎，不过人数还是不太够。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
It's easy to figure out the number of monsters when you deal with them hotly. How about you? Would you like to participate in the investigation of this place?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
和魔物交战时，正好能观察它们的数量。你愿意参与这里的调查吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参加

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Yeah, that's right...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
嗯，没错...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Then I'll be shivering a little longer...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
那我还得继续在这里发抖一阵子了...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Oh yes!! Thanks!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
太好了！！谢谢你！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
After entering, kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
进去后，击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
I look forward to your hot hunting skills~~!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
期待你大展身手，热火朝天地狩猎哦~~！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Ah, I think this should be enough for today!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
啊，我想今天的调查到这里就够了！！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
If you come after tomorrow, you'll have something else to do~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
明天再来，就有别的事情要做了哦～

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Ah, nice to meet you!! Are you here today to help with the investigation??
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
啊，很高兴见到你！！今天也是来帮忙调查的吗？？

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Your help is the same as last time~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
今天要做的事和上次一样哦～

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
击杀100只任意种类的魔物。你愿意参加吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参加

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Okay... I'll keep shivering in the cold...
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
好吧...那我就继续在这里冻得发抖吧...

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Thank you
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
After entering, kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
进去后，击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
那就小心行动！

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Kill 100 monsters regardless of type.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
击杀100只任意种类的魔物即可。

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Have you finished already? You've done it hotly as expected~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
已经完成了吗？果然干得热火朝天呢～

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Then I'll do the rest of the research for you~
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
剩下的研究就交给我吧～

scripts.text:
[Elysia]
Thank you for your hard work. I hope we can meet again!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莉西亚]
辛苦你了，希望我们还能再见面！！

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Hello, Adventurer
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
你好，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I am Radimir from the Illusion Investigation.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
我是幻觉调查队的拉迪米尔。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I'm sent to such a dreary place, and honestly, I'm very afraid
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
我被派到这么阴森的地方，说实话，心里很害怕。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I'd like you to conduct the investigation together, but... you haven't joined the investigation team yet.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
我本想邀请你一起调查...不过你还没加入调查队。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Would you like to do something meaningful with me?
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
愿意和我一起做件有意义的事吗？

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
If you are interested, please meet <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera, and join the Investigation Team and come back.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
如果你有兴趣，请去普隆德拉找指挥官<NAVI>[乔尔]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>加入调查队，然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Hello, Adventurer
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
你好，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I am Radimir from the Illusion Investigation.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
我是幻觉调查队的拉迪米尔。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I'm sent to such a dreary place, and honestly, I'm very afraid
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
我被派到这么阴森的地方，说实话，心里很害怕。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
But I've always been interested in the phenomenon of illusion, and when the investigation team was founded, I actively applied for membership.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
不过我一直对幻觉现象很感兴趣，调查队成立时，我就主动申请加入了。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Because nobody has figured it out yet
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
毕竟至今还没有人弄清楚幻觉的真相。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
It's just the beginning of the current investigation, but it's sure to be a great first step
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
这次调查才刚刚开始，但一定会迈出重要的第一步。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Therefore, fear can be overcome by will.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
所以只要有决心，就能克服恐惧。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Investigation preparations are complete, now I'm waiting for someone who can adjust the monsters' levels.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
调查准备已经就绪，现在只等有人来调整魔物的等级。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
How about you, why don't you participate in the investigation? You joined the investigation team for that, right?
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
你呢？既然都加入调查队了，为什么不来参加调查？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参加

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I'll stay here
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
我会留在这里。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Good.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
好。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Just kill 100 monsters of any type here.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
在这里击杀100只任意种类的魔物就行。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
The sooner the better.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
越快越好。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Then I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
那我等你回来。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
That's it for today.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
今天就到这里吧。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
If the current trend, I think we can resume the investigation in a day or so. Please come then.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
照目前的情况，应该再过一天左右就能继续调查了。到时候请再来。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Hello, are you here today to help with the investigation?
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
你好，今天是来帮忙调查的吗？

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Please execute the operation as it was then.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
请按上次的流程继续调查。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Would you like to participate in the task of killing 100 monsters of any type?
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
愿意参加击杀100只任意种类魔物的任务吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参加

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
You acted meaninglessly, I'm disappointed.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
你这样做毫无意义，真让我失望。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Thank you
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Then I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
那我等你回来。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
You came through quickly, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
你这么快就回来了，多谢。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
That makes it easier to work out the numbers.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
这样一来，统计数量就容易多了。

scripts.text:
[Radimir]
I will finish the rest of the work soon and report it to the investigation team. Thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[拉迪米尔]
我会尽快完成剩下的工作，并向调查队汇报。辛苦你了。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Hello!!!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
你好！！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I'm Machoko from the Illusion Investigation Team~
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我是幻觉调查队的玛乔可～

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I really wanted to be dispatched to this place, but I was lucky.
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我一直很想被派到这里来，能如愿以偿真是太幸运了。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
These damn teddy bears~~ The teddy bears...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
这些该死的泰迪熊～～泰迪熊...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
But it's impossible for me... I don't have enough strength... But you haven't joined the investigation team yet...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
可我一个人对付不了...实力不够...而你还没加入调查队...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
You can sign up by going to <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera. Sign up and come here~
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
去普隆德拉找指挥官<NAVI>[乔尔]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>报名加入，然后再来这里找我～

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Hello!!!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
你好！！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I'm Machoko from the Illusion Investigation Team~
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我是幻觉调查队的玛乔可～

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I really wanted to be dispatched to this place, but I was lucky.
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我一直很想被派到这里来，能如愿以偿真是太幸运了。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
These damn teddy bears~~ The teddy bears...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
这些该死的泰迪熊～～泰迪熊...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
But it's impossible for me... I don't have enough strength... He looks easy... but he's so strong...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
可我一个人对付不了...实力不够...那家伙看着挺好欺负...其实强得很...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I thought I could do it all by myself... I took it too lightly... Huh...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我还以为自己一个人就能搞定...真是太轻敌了...唉...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I unknowingly and vigorously attacked and came back with a lot of beating... I almost died...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我当时一时冲动就猛冲上去，结果被揍得够呛...差点没命...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I barely recovered... I think it's possible to investigate, but you look a little strong?
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我好不容易才缓过来...调查应该还能继续，不过你看起来挺强的？

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Then help me... I need someone to take control of those vicious teddy bears...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
那就拜托你了...我需要有人帮忙对付那些凶恶的泰迪熊...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
How about it? Do you want to join the investigation??
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
怎么样？愿意参加调查吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参加

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Yes... I'm about to collapse after I've been here... Like a man without blood or tears...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
是啊...我在这里待得快撑不下去了...都快变得麻木不仁了...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Okay! Let's go!!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
好！出发吧！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Go and beat up about 100 of them, and come, it doesn't matter what type, blow them up as you see them!!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
去击杀大约100只，然后回来。什么种类都行，看到就尽管打倒！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I... can't even move... Here... I'll wait...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我...连动都动不了了...我就在这里...等你...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Well, no more today
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
好了，今天先到这里吧。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Come back after a day!!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
一天后再来！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Oh, nice to meet you! Welcome back!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
啊，很高兴见到你！欢迎回来！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
You must have come here because your body itches.
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
你一定是手痒了才会来这里吧。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Would you like to participate in the investigation work here again today??
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
今天还想参加这里的调查吗？？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参加

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
What...then why did you come??
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
什么...那你来这里做什么？？

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Sure, that's how it should be
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
好啊，就该这样。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Regardless of the type, just beat 100 of them and bring them back.
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
不管是什么种类，击杀100只后回来找我就行。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I'll be waiting for you, so hurry up!!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我会在这里等你，快去快回！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Go and beat up about 100 of them, and come, it doesn't matter what type, blow them up as you see them!!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
去击杀大约100只，然后回来。什么种类都行，看到就尽管打倒！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
I've been waiting for you... finish quickly and come back...
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
我一直在等你...快点完成后回来...

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Um...but that's about it... um...yeah!! good!!
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
嗯...差不多就是这样...嗯...好！！

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Leave the rest to me!! I'll report the results to the investigation team, now you can go and rest.
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
剩下的交给我！！我会把结果汇报给调查队，你可以去休息了。

scripts.text:
[Machoko]
Thank you~~
scripts.translation:
[玛乔可]
谢谢你～～

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Hello!
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
你好！

scripts.text:
[Orian]
I'm Orian, a contract worker in the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
我是奥里安，幻觉调查队雇来的临时工。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Actually, it's not something I'm keen on...but I need the money...
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
其实我对这份工作不太感兴趣...不过我需要钱...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
It would be nice if you could help me... is that possible?
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
要是你能帮帮我就好了...可以吗？

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Uh, but you haven't joined the investigation team yet.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
呃，不过你还没加入调查队。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Please apply for membership to <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera, and come!!
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
请先去普隆德拉找指挥官<NAVI>[乔尔]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>申请加入，然后再过来！！

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Hello!
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
你好！

scripts.text:
[Orian]
I'm Orian, a contract worker in the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
我是奥里安，幻觉调查队雇来的临时工。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
The Illumination Investigation Team is a newly formed organization, so it must have been a little understaffed. I saw an announcement that they would hire part-time contract workers.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
幻觉调查队刚成立不久，人手可能不太够。我看到公告说他们要招兼职临时工。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Actually, I'm not interested in illusions... I'm busy making a living.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
说实话，我对幻觉不感兴趣...我还得忙着赚钱呢。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Huh... It's all about money, I'm going to buy a new set of clothes when I get paid.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
唉，说到底还是为了钱。发了工资，我就去买套新衣服。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
But even that isn't easy... I've been waiting for an investigator like you to come because I think it's going to be very difficult on my own.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
不过赚钱也不容易...我一直盼着有调查员来帮忙，自己一个人实在应付不来。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
It would be nice if you could help me... is that possible?
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
要是你能帮帮我就好了...可以吗？

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Would you like to participate in this Illusion Investigation?
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
你愿意参加这次幻觉调查吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参加

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Ah... I finally found an investigator... Ah... I want money...
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
啊...终于等到调查员了...啊...我想赚钱...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Oh, thank you
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
哦，谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Please go up one floor from here and go to the bleak Guyang Palace.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
从这里再往上一层，前往荒凉的龟阳宫吧。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
And please kill 100 monsters there, regardless of type.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
在那里击杀100只魔物，种类不限。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
I'll be waiting for you here. Have a safe trip!!
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
我会在这里等你。一路小心！！

scripts.text:
[Orian]
You're not fit to do research right now.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
你现在还不适合做调查。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
I think it will be fine by tomorrow, can you come back after tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
我想明天应该就能继续了。你明天再来好吗？

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Hello, you are the only one who can help me...
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
你好...你是唯一能帮我的人...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
What we need to do is the same as last time...
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
要做的事和上次一样...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Are you going to help me with the illusion investigation again?
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
你愿意再次帮我调查幻觉吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参加

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Aigoo...
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
唉呀...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Sob.....
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
呜呜...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Oops... Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
哎呀...谢谢你...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Go to the bleak archery and kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
去荒凉的射箭场，击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Then be careful...
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
那就小心点...

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Destroy 100 monsters of any type in the bleak Archery.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
在荒凉的射箭场击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
You came home safely.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
你平安回来了。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Uh... You took it down a lot faster than I expected.. You... you were a master??
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
呃...你完成得比我预想的快多了...你、你是高手吗？

scripts.text:
[Orian]
That should make the rest of the work easier.
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
这样一来，剩下的工作就容易多了。

scripts.text:
[Orian]
Thank you~ Thank you for your hard work!!
scripts.translation:
[奥里安]
谢谢你～辛苦了！！

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
你好，很高兴认识你。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I am Sheshin belonging to the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我是幻觉调查队的谢辛。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I thought my fighting power would be enough to investigate here... but I guess I made a mistake.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我原以为自己的实力足以在这里调查...看来是我估计错了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
The monsters here are much stronger than I expected.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
这里的魔物比我预想的强得多。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Ah... I'm really proud of myself... but I need help... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
唉...我还挺自信的...可还是需要帮忙...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Adventurer hasn't joined the Illusion Investigation Team yet.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
冒险者，你还没有加入幻觉调查队。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Would you like to join the Illusionary Investigation Team? Wouldn't it be exciting to explore unknown phenomena?
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
你想加入幻觉调查队吗？探索未知现象不是很令人兴奋吗？

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
If you would like to sign up, please go see Commander <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI> in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
想报名的话，请去普隆德拉找指挥官<NAVI>[乔尔]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
很高兴认识你。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I am Sheshin belonging to the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我是幻觉调查队的谢辛。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I was active as a member of the Continental Guard in the past. At that time, I was tasked with exploring the dimensional rift created by the power of the demon king Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我以前是大陆卫兵的一员，曾奉命调查魔王梦罗克之力所形成的次元裂缝。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I was guessing to some extent that the illusions appearing everywhere had something to do with the power of the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我早就猜测，各地出现的幻觉可能与次元裂缝之力有关。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
It has been officially announced by Commander Joel that the Illusion is a phenomenon caused by a dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
指挥官乔尔已经正式宣布，幻觉现象是由次元裂缝引起的。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
And soon a new illusion was discovered, yes... right here
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
没过多久，我们又发现了一处新的幻觉...没错，就在这里。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I joined the Illusion Investigation Team because I wanted to see it with my own eyes, and now I am here.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我加入幻觉调查队，就是想亲眼看看这种现象。现在我终于来到这里了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
But I ran into a little problem...
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
不过，我遇到了一点麻烦...

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I thought my fighting power would be enough to investigate here... but I guess I made a mistake.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我原以为自己的实力足以在这里调查...看来是我判断失误了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
The monsters here are much stronger than I expected.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
这里的魔物比我预想的强得多。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Ah... I really hurt my pride... but I need help...
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
唉...这可真伤自尊...不过我确实需要帮忙...

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Hmm... I think it's possible enough for you as an adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
嗯...以你的冒险者实力，应该足以胜任...

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I feel that you have much more power than me.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我觉得你的实力比我强多了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Would you like to help me investigate the illusions in this sector?
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
愿意帮我调查这片区域的幻觉吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参加

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
This must be a good opportunity for adventurers...
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
这对冒险者来说应该是个不错的机会...

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Good.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
好。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Please kill 100 monsters of any type located inside here.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
请在这里击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Then, please travel carefully without getting hurt.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
路上请多加小心，别受伤了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
You don't have to do any more research today.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
今天不用再继续调查了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Can you come back tomorrow if you want?
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
如果你愿意，明天再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Welcome, you're here to help investigate the illusion, right?
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
欢迎回来，你是来帮忙调查幻觉现象的吧？

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
You can do the same thing as last time.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
今天照上次那样做就行。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate?
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
击杀100只任意种类的魔物。你愿意参加吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参加

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
It's a pity, it's sad that I still lack strength.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
真遗憾...看来我的实力还是不够。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Good.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
好。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Then, please travel carefully without getting hurt.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
路上请多加小心，别受伤了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I see... you finished quickly and came back.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
原来如此...你很快就完成并回来了。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I need to investigate further to see if the phenomenon here is also affected by the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
我还得继续调查，确认这里的现象是否也受到次元裂缝的影响。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
I'll do the work myself from now on.
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
接下来的工作我自己来做。

scripts.text:
[Sheshin]
Thank you so much for your help
scripts.translation:
[谢辛]
真的非常感谢你帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Hello.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
This is Cassis of the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我是幻觉调查队的卡西斯。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Although this place is full of monsters, I still feel comfortable here.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
这里虽然到处都是魔物，但我待着反而觉得很自在。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
I heard that one of the investigators is coming to help... is that you?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我听说有位调查员会来帮忙...是你吗？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Oh, that's not true. You're not a member of the investigation team... Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
哦，不对，你还不是调查队的成员...嗯。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Would you like to join the Illusionary Investigation Team too? Would you like to investigate strange phenomena?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你也想加入幻觉调查队吗？想不想和我们一起调查这些奇异现象？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
If you don't mind, please apply for membership with the Commander <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI> in Prontera and come!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
如果你愿意，请去普隆德拉找指挥官<NAVI>[乔尔]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>申请加入，然后再来这里！

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Hello
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
This is Cassis of the Illusion Investigation Corps.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我是幻觉调查队的卡西斯。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Although this place is full of monsters, I still feel comfortable here.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
这里虽然到处都是魔物，但我待着反而觉得很自在。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
I don't like to get involved with people. Before I joined the investigation team, I ran a shop in Prontera...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我不喜欢和人打交道。加入调查队之前，我在普隆德拉开过一家店...

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
I don't like the feeling of being crowded, so it was hard to bear... I guess meeting a lot of people was stressful for my personality.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我不喜欢被人群围着，实在很难受...对我这种性格来说，跟很多人打交道压力太大了。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Although this place is full of monsters, I still feel comfortable here, at least the monsters don't talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
这里虽然到处都是魔物，我待着却很自在。至少魔物不会跟我说话。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Ummm, by the way, I heard that one of the investigators is coming to help... I guess that's you?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
嗯，对了，听说有位调查员要来帮忙...我想那个人就是你吧？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Have you heard the general information from Captain Joel? You just need to display your fighting power without hesitation!!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
指挥官乔尔跟你说过大致情况了吗？你只要放手展示自己的实力就行！！

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Would you like to participate in the investigation of this place?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你愿意参与这里的调查吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参加

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Uh, then who the hell is the investigative team coming...?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
呃，那来帮忙的调查员到底在哪儿...？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Okay, thank you
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
好，谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Just kill 100 monsters of any type that exist here.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
在这里击杀100只任意种类的魔物就行。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Then good luck.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
那就祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Today's investigation is complete.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
今天的调查到此结束。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
It would be nice if you could come tomorrow too... Please stop by if you have time.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
明天你要是也能来就好了...有空的话过来一趟吧。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Hello, are you here today to help with the investigation?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你好，今天是来帮忙调查的吗？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
The content is the same as last time.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
今天的内容和上次一样。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
击杀100只任意种类的魔物。你愿意参加吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参加

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
It would be nice if you could help me today...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你今天要是能帮帮我就好了...

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
I like it!!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
太好了！！

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
After entering, kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
进去后，击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
那就小心行动！

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Welcome, you're done!!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
欢迎回来，任务完成了！！

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
You've worked really hard. Are there any injuries anywhere?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
辛苦了。有没有哪里受伤？

scripts.text:
[Cassis]
Leave the rest to me. Thanks
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
剩下的交给我吧，谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Hello
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I need help with my research work, so I'm looking for a suitable helper.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我的研究需要人手，所以正在找合适的帮手。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
You're not the right person yet, sorry.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
抱歉，你目前还不合适。

scripts.text: ^4d4dff== This is a level 180 or higher quest. ==^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff== 这是等级达到180级或以上才能接取的任务。 ==^000000

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Hello~
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
你好～

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I am Lista who is active in the Illusion Investigation Team.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我是利斯特，幻觉调查队的一员。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
It's been a while since I came down to the deep sea with Master.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
好久没和师父一起下到深海区域了。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I'm always working hard, but I don't think Master still approves of me.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我一直很努力，可师父似乎还是不认可我。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Just in time, the Illusion Investigation Team said they needed to investigate the deep sea here, so I quickly applied.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
正好幻觉调查队需要调查这片深海，我就赶紧报名了。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I'm sure Master would be happy if we could get even a little bit more information about the deep sea here as part of the investigation team!!!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
如果能作为调查队的一员，多收集一些这里的深海情报，师父一定会很高兴！！！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Would you like to come with me?
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
你愿意和我一起去吗？

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Uh, but you haven't joined the investigation team yet.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
呃，不过你还没有加入调查队。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Please apply for membership to <NAVI>[Joel]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>, the Commander in Prontera, and come!!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
请先去普隆德拉找指挥官<NAVI>[乔尔]<INFO>prt_in,136,34,</INFO></NAVI>申请加入，然后再过来！！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Hello~
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
你好～

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I am Lista who is active in the Illusion Investigation Team.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我是利斯特，幻觉调查队的一员。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
It's been a while since I came down to the deep sea with Master.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
好久没和师父一起下到深海区域了。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I'm always working hard, but I don't think Master still approves of me.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我一直很努力，可师父似乎还是不认可我。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Just in time, the Illusion Investigation Team said they needed to investigate the deep sea here, so I quickly applied.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
正好幻觉调查队需要调查这片深海，我就赶紧报名了。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I'm sure Master would be happy if we could get even a little bit more information about the deep sea here as part of the investigation team!!!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
如果能作为调查队的一员，多收集一些这里的深海情报，师父一定会很高兴！！！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I was anxiously waiting for a member to help me with the investigation, and it went really well~
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我正着急等人来帮忙调查呢，幸好你及时赶到了～

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Would you like to participate in this deep sea investigation?
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
愿意参加这次深海调查吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参加

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I'm neglected like this... It's wrong to be acknowledged by Master...
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我总被这样冷落...看来师父根本不打算认可我...

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Oh, thank you!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
哦，谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Go down to the lower level dungeon of the Abyssal Undersea Cave and defeat 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
前往深渊海底洞穴下层，击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
那就小心行动！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Let's finish here for today.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
今天就先到这里吧。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I should be able to get back to work tomorrow, could you talk to me again then??
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
我明天应该就能继续工作了，到时候你能再来找我吗？

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Hello, would you like to do some research with me today??
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
你好，今天想和我一起调查吗？

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Just do what you did last time!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
照上次那样做就行！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
If you kill 100 monsters of any type, would you like to participate?
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
击杀100只任意种类的魔物。你愿意参加吗？

scripts.text: Participate
scripts.translation: 参加

scripts.text: Do not participate
scripts.translation: 不参加

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Today... I... incompetent... disciple...
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
今天...我...真是个没用的弟子...

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Good! Got it
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
很好，明白了。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Go down to the lower level of the Abyssal Undersea Cave and kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
前往深渊海底洞穴下层，击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
那就小心行动！

scripts.text:
[Lister]
Kill 100 monsters of any type.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
击杀100只任意种类的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
How was it? Are the monsters on the lower levels really strong??
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
怎么样？下层的魔物是不是很强？

scripts.text:
[Lister]
You worked hard... Then I'll have to go down carefully.
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
辛苦你了...看来我也得小心地下去调查。

scripts.text:
[Lister]
I'll do the rest, thank you so much!!
scripts.translation:
[利斯特]
剩下的交给我吧，非常感谢！！
